shard.basis: members of group battery-doclist (origin rule) in the current release (7224r3a)

name: doclist
label: Use a directory list for health care plan

questions.text:
There are many different types of health care plans. I'd like to know which type of plan is most like yours. Please tell me if your plan has any of these features: 
A. Is there a book, directory or list of doctors whom you must use?

name: anydoc
label: Can choose any doctor i like

questions.text:
There are many different types of health care plans. I'd like to know which type of plan is most like yours. Please tell me if your plan has any of these features: 
B. Can you choose any doctor you like in your community or elsewhere, perhaps paying part of the bill?
